content.text: {"core": "Wisdom holds knowing sealed until conditions warrant its release. In Abstraction, it operates on the model — the structure lifted clear of the particulars it was drawn from. Too Much, the withholding compounds: each abstraction is deferred into a deeper one, and the model refines itself past any instance it could organize. Knowing seals against use.", "sheetLine": "The model keeps climbing away from the ground it was built to hold."}
